subject: math
description: Write a circle equation when the center and one point on the circle are given.
learningObjectives: Use a point-on-circle condition to determine the radius
Find the squared radius using horizontal, vertical, or distance-formula reasoning
Write a complete circle equation in center-radius form
Check whether a given point satisfies a circle equation
Avoid common mistakes involving signs and squared radius
prerequisites: Plotting ordered pairs on the Cartesian plane
Using the center-radius form of a circle
Finding horizontal, vertical, and diagonal distances between points
